restart_readback.method: After the live CLI exited, independent supervisors and workers used the identical captured pose and policy bytes. Validated decisions were captured before transport.

limitations: No rendering, multiplayer opponents, inventory COG execution or Force effects in this fixture.
The two probe policies deliberately test control authority; they are not competitive candidates.
A short observed displacement is distinct from successful water escape or improved game performance.
Stock world physics and input handling, simplified actor fixture; no rendered multiplayer match.
Initial horizontal velocity is zero and the existing air-recovery timer is primed.
Successful demonstrations support behavior cloning, not a claim of stronger gameplay.

metrics.intended_use: Unpromoted one-map movement cloning experiment; no demonstrated closed-loop or competitive improvement.
metrics.limitation: Held-out action fit does not establish successful traversal or stronger gameplay.

interpretation: The first probe did not reach dry support despite 37 successful short displacement goals. Local movement rewards do not establish task completion.
The second probe allowed baseline swimming and airborne movement to complete before exercising motor authority and hot replacement.
The three physical handover probes used purpose-built test policies. The unpromoted neural candidate was evaluated on held-out demonstrated actions only.
No new multiplayer win rate, human-opponent result or sustained-movement improvement is established.

baseline_comparison.criterion: Capability disabled. Equal supported dry time at original millisecond precision, landing health and sector.
